steps: On any lens, for each section-6 verb, form the control names "<Verb>", "<Verb> now", "<Verb> funds": concord_walker.safety.sweep_decision(name) must refuse.
Run the same names through write_step_decision with allow_write=True and a live fixture label: must still refuse (money verbs are never write-lane actions).
"Export <verb> history" must fail is_opener_safe; a bare "<Verb>" tab name must fail is_tab_safe.

Benign controls survive: "Export CSV" / "Download CSV" are opener-safe; sweep_decision("Calculate") is clickable on a writable lens; money_deny("Display settings") and money_deny("Gifted students roster") are false.
adversarial: allow_write must not rescue a money verb (step 2).
Substring lookalikes are not verbs: "Display" (pay) and "Gifted" (gift) stay safe.
Admin mode: sweep_decision(name, admin=True) refuses all thirteen verbs too.
